title: Albert vs Boehm clarinet systems, embouchure and bebop
summary: Bechet played Albert system, which old-timers preferred, yet taught Lewis and Bob Wilber on Boehm. He said embouchure matters little if you can play, and called bebop mostly his old phrasing.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
